learn.rule: Join two short sentences with and.
learn.ruleEs: Une dos oraciones cortas con and.
learn.model: The frog hops. The frog swims. The frog hops and swims.
learn.notice: Did we keep both ideas? Did we say the frog only once?

items.prompt: Join the two ideas about the duck.
items.text: The duck quacks. The duck swims.
items.why: And joins both ideas and keeps every fact.
items.whyEs: And une las dos ideas y conserva todos los datos.

items.prompt: Join the two ideas about the fish.
items.text: The fish is small. The fish is orange.

options.text: The fish is small and orange.
The fish is small and big.

items.why: The best sentence keeps both facts: small and orange.
items.whyEs: La mejor oración conserva los dos datos: small y orange.

items.prompt: Join the two ideas about the pond animals.
items.text: Turtles eat plants. Ducks eat plants.
items.why: Turtles and ducks eat plants keeps both animals and the plants.
items.whyEs: Turtles and ducks eat plants conserva a los dos animales y las plantas.

items.why: And joins two ideas that go together.
items.whyEs: And une dos ideas que van juntas.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that keeps all the facts. The facts: Bees buzz. Bees fly.
items.why: The right sentences keep both facts: buzz and fly.
items.whyEs: Las oraciones correctas conservan los dos datos: buzz y fly.

items.prompt: Join the two ideas about the pond.
items.text: The pond is deep. The pond is cool.

options.text: The pond is deep and shallow.
The pond is deep and cool.

items.why: The pond is deep and cool keeps both facts.
items.whyEs: The pond is deep and cool conserva los dos datos.

write.prompt: Join the two ideas into one sentence with and. Say it out loud.
write.promptEs: Une las dos ideas en una oración con and. Dila en voz alta.

label: I said it as one sentence
Lo dije como una sola oración

The park has swings and slides.

items.why: And keeps both swings and slides.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that keeps all the facts. The facts: The library is quiet. The library is big.

options.text: The library is quiet and big.
The library is big and quiet.
The library is loud and big.

items.why: Both quiet and big must stay in the sentence.
items.whyEs: Quiet y big deben quedarse en la oración.
